findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: serp, serp_batch, serp_multi, serp_read, scrape, github, hackernews, related_papers, lit_review · Private data: serp_multi, scrape, domain_info, dns_propagation, sec_edgar, cve · Public sink: serp, geocode · Destructive: related_queries.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: serp, serp_batch, serp_multi, serp_read, scrape, github, hackernews, related_papers, lit_review · Private data: serp_multi, scrape, domain_info, dns_propagation, sec_edgar, cve · Public sink: serp, geocode · Destructive: related_queries

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
